title: SEC3: tls_active doc comment contradicts STARTTLS
description: The doc comment on SessionContext::tls_active (context.rs lines 17-20) states there is no STARTTLS upgrade and connections are TLS or not from the first byte. This is factually wrong. STARTTLS is implemented and tls_active is set to true after a successful upgrade in run_session_post_starttls. The comment is stale from a pre-STARTTLS state. A reader relying on it could incorrectly assume tls_active=true implies an implicit-TLS accept path, missing the STARTTLS-upgraded path. The comment must be updated to reflect both origins of tls_active=true.
